race.comment: NICOFFHOME (2) is the one to beat despite a plain Morphettville run in BM62 Saturday company, where he was beaten over 11 lengths after racing keenly. He had missed by a nose at this track the start prior, has a win and a placing from two runs at this venue, and the 2kg claim helps him reset in easier grade. NIGHTOWL (8) won his Mdn at Yarra Valley as favourite on soft ground, overcoming early and late interference, and he has already won around 2025m. He can keep the ball rolling. FRANK EXPRESS (3) brings proven staying depth and arrived off a Moe win where he was held up until the 150m before beating Stole Him by a length. CROWN OF RUSSIA (6) looks better suited coming back in distance and an improved run is on the cards.
